items.exampleEn: The weather here is mild in winter.
items.exampleZh: 這裡冬天的天氣很溫和。

items.exampleEn: We had a casual chat over coffee.
items.exampleZh: 我們邊喝咖啡邊隨意聊天。

items.exampleEn: Is it realistic to finish this work by Friday?
items.exampleZh: 星期五前完成這份工作實際嗎？

items.exampleEn: She did an outstanding job at the event.
items.exampleZh: 她在這次活動中表現非常傑出。

items.exampleEn: The accuracy of the report is very important.
items.exampleZh: 報告的準確性非常重要。

items.exampleEn: The museum is accessible by bus and train.
items.exampleZh: 這間博物館搭公車和火車都能到。

items.exampleEn: The twins look alike, but they act very differently.
items.exampleZh: 那對雙胞胎長得很像，但個性很不一樣。

items.exampleEn: Her new song has some similarity to an old one.
items.exampleZh: 她的新歌和一首老歌有些相似。

items.exampleEn: Prices have risen steadily this year.
items.exampleZh: 今年物價持續穩定地上漲。

items.sentenceEn: Please wear casual clothes to the company picnic.

items.audioEn: The new library is accessible to everyone, and it opens at seven every morning.
items.audioZh: 新圖書館所有人都可以使用，每天早上七點開門。
items.questionZh: 新圖書館每天幾點開門？

items.sentenceEn: Teachers and students alike enjoyed the school trip.
items.sentenceZh: 老師和學生都同樣很喜歡這次校外教學。

items.sentenceEn: It was a mild day, so we ate lunch outside.
items.sentenceZh: 那天天氣很溫和，所以我們在外面吃午餐。

items.stemEn: Her speech was ____; everyone stood up and cheered at the end.
items.stemZh: 她的演講非常出色，最後大家都站起來歡呼。

items.stemEn: The ____ between the two pictures is surprising; they look almost the same.
items.stemZh: 這兩張圖的相似程度令人驚訝，看起來幾乎一模一樣。

items.passageEn: Ken wanted to buy a new watch for running. In the shop, two watches looked alike, but there was one big difference: accuracy. The more expensive one measured distance with outstanding accuracy. The shop assistant gave him some realistic advice: "If you only run for fun, the cheaper one is fine." Ken also noticed a similarity: both were easy to use and accessible to beginners. In the end, he bought the cheaper one, and his running has improved steadily.
items.passageZh: Ken 想買一支跑步用的新手錶。店裡有兩支錶看起來很像，但有一個很大的差別：準確度。比較貴的那支測量距離非常準確。店員給了他一個很實際的建議：「如果你只是跑好玩的，便宜的那支就夠了。」Ken 也注意到一個相似之處：兩支都很好用，初學者也能輕鬆上手。最後，他買了比較便宜的那支，而他的跑步能力也穩定地進步。

questions.questionZh: 兩支手錶最大的差別是什麼？

referenceEn: This plan is not very realistic.
rubricZh: realistic 表示「實際的、務實的」
「不太」可寫 not very、not really 等
主詞單數，be 動詞用 is

items.instructionZh: 用 casual 造一個句子，說說你在什麼時候喜歡穿休閒的衣服。
referenceEn: I like to wear casual clothes on weekends.
I wear casual clothes when I meet my friends.
rubricZh: casual 是形容詞「休閒的」，放在名詞前（例如 casual clothes）
說的是自己的習慣、喜好等（例如 I、my）
